{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm
df_treatment = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Check severity distribution by sex in treatment arm
severity_sex = pd.crosstab(df_treatment['sex'], df_treatment['severity'])
print('Severity distribution by sex in treatment arm:')
print(severity_sex)

# Compute response rate by sex in treatment arm
response_by_sex = df_treatment.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()
print('\nResponse rate by sex in treatment arm:')
print(response_by_sex)

# Compute response rate by severity in treatment arm
response_by_severity = df_treatment.groupby('severity')['responded'].mean()
print('\nResponse rate by severity in treatment arm:')
print(response_by_severity)

# Compute crude difference in response rates by sex
crude_diff = response_by_sex['F'] - response_by_sex['M']
print(f'\nCrude difference (F - M): {crude_diff:.4f}')"}
